item.description:
What's new in 0.1.51

  • Language now switches live - pick one in Settings - Options or on the onboarding language screen and the whole app updates instantly, no relaunch.
  • More localization: the "Stay awake for…" duration picker (15 min / 1 hour / Until… / Custom), Quiet Hours weekday letters and times, and the compact durations shown in Stats, timers and the menu bar (e.g. 112h 47m) now follow your language and locale.
  • Weekday letters and clock times across the app now use your locale's format (24-hour where that's the norm).
